description: The only IPC granted to the main and Owner Assist consoles at the local sidecar origin. Window chrome and events support dragging, zoom, and theme sync. The folder chooser returns only a user-selected path. The desktop session command returns only this app's current sidecar credentials. No shell, updater, filesystem, app show/hide, or native prompt permissions are granted. These permissions belong in the remote capability, not main.json, which does not apply to the loopback page.
